units.source_text: 左思右想，此别实甚难堪。”

en.t: After thinking it over from every side, she found this parting truly hard to bear.

units.source_text: 其时行色匆匆，但回信不可不写。

en.t: At the time she was hurriedly preparing to depart, but she still had to write a reply.

units.source_text: 斋宫的答诗由侍女长代作：

en.t: The High Priestess's reply poem was composed on her behalf by the chief lady-in-waiting:
